adds.title: Minnesota conversion therapy ban - State law April 2023 and Executive Order July 2021
adds.summary: On April 26, 2023 Minnesota banned medical and mental-health practitioners from providing conversion therapy to minors and vulnerable adults, banned advertising that describes LGBTQ identities as a mental disease, disorder or illness or promises to change sexual orientation or gender identity, made violations subject to discipline by health licensing boards, and barred insurers and health plans from paying for conversion therapy, and enacted a gender-affirming-care shield law barring state authorities from honoring out-of-state subpoenas or arrest warrants for providing gender-affirming care, protecting families traveling to Minnesota for care, following a March 2023 executive order directing the Department of Health to summarize scientific literature on the safety and effectiveness of gender-affirming care and confirming providers could bill insurance for such care.
